facts.claim: Marina (Oceania Cruises): Entered service 2011; 66,084 GT; 1250 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 239 m length; Oceania class.
MS Marina is an Oceania-class cruise ship, which was constructed at Fincantieri's Sestri Ponente yards in Italy for Oceania Cruises.
Marina is the first in a duo of cruise ships, and was followed by MS Riviera in May 2012.
The option for the third ship was declined.
The ship was named in Miami by Mary Hart on 5 February 2011.
